lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately seven visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial slits; spacing between centroids increases towards the posterior and ventral regions.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs, creating a lattice-like pattern of high-contrast anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible; the most prominent displays a sharp luminance gradient—bright on the superior edge and shadowed on the inferior edge—running from the upper gill slit toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the anterior margin and mid-section of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin; multiple elongated, high-contrast silhouettes (external commensal organisms) are attached to the pectoral fin and the mid-lateral flank.
